example.title: Abbott's Parker Through Truss Bridge, Abbott Road (CR 33) over the Sandusky River
example.place: Tiffin vicinity, Pleasant Township, Seneca County, OH

brief: Single-span, pin-connected Parker through truss with a polygonal (curved-profile) top chord, 184 ft clear span (218 ft with approaches) and a 15 ft one-lane roadway, on concrete-capped Berea sandstone abutments. Top chords and end posts are laced channels with cover plates, bottom chords and diagonals flat eyebars, portal and sway bracing of laced angles; a low lattice railing runs inside the trusses, W-beam guardrail on the approaches. Stands alone in open cornfields on a gravel-shouldered county road with trees along the riverbank (photos are HAER 1986 via Wikimedia Commons; truss height and panel count estimated from photo 2).
